lines.text: Find setups checks your list against conditions you pick, on closed candles.
Five steps: pick a list, a chart and a scan, run it, and read the results.
Each condition narrows the list. A stock matches only when it passes all of them. The counts here are made up.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
What it does not do: a match is information, not a signal to trade and not advice.
It does not rank stocks as good or bad, or say what price does next.
It never places, changes or cancels an order. Every decision stays yours.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
Open the ATP website on your phone or computer. The Sign in screen appears.
Where your team set them up, buttons such as Continue with Google sit at the top.
Or type your email here, then your password.
Press Sign in. The app opens on Today.
Forgot your password? Tap Forgot password, and ATP sends a reset link.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
On a computer, Find setups is in the left menu, under Find. On a phone, tap it in the bottom bar.
Not in the bar? Tap More and search for scan.
Tap Find setups to open it.
If you see Coming soon, it is not switched on for your organisation yet. Ask your administrator.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
A quick tour of the page, top to bottom.
Your list: the stocks that are scanned. Change picks another list.
Chart: the size of one candle, for example Daily.
Start a scan: a ready scan, a template, or your own words.
Conditions: the current scan's conditions.
Results: they appear after your first run.
More tools holds the rest.
Each one shows only when it is switched on.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
